claim: Direct trains run hourly from Knokke-Heist to Bruges in about 17 minutes for roughly €5-8.
quote: The fastest way to get from Knokke-Heist to Bruges is by train, which takes 17 minutes and costs $5 - $8.

claim: Above-ground on-street parking in central Bruges is punitive (€7 for 2h, €18 for 4h); the recommended approach is the underground 't Zand car park, a 10-minute walk to the Markt.
quote: Centrum-'t Zand: a 10-minute walk to Market Square ... €1.00 for up to 30 minutes, €3.00 for 1 hour, €7.00 for 2 hours, €12.00 for 3 hours, and €18.00 for 4 hours.

claim: Bruges' historic centre has car-free and low-traffic restricted-access zones enforced via ANPR cameras, so day-trippers should park on the ring and walk in.
quote: There are three colour zones, each with specific regulations: car-free refers to a complete ban on motorised vehicle use, while restricted access means that specific target groups ... are allowed access under certain conditions

claim: Five licensed operators run identical 30-minute canal boat tours from five embarkation points (Rederij Stael, Gruuthuse, De Meulemeester, Coudenys, Venetië van het Noorden) at the same fixed price.
quote: Five boat companies operate tours: Rederij Stael (Katelijnestraat 4), Rederij Gruuthuse (Nieuwstraat 11), Rederij De Meulemeester (Wollestraat 32), Rederij Coudenys (Rozenhoedkaai), Rederij Venetië van het Noorden (Huidenvettersplein 13)

claim: Canal-boat season runs 13 February to 30 December 2026, daily 10:00-17:00/17:30; €15 adult, €9 child 4-11, under-4s free, no advance booking for individuals.
quote: Opening hours run from February 13, 2026 to December 30, 2026, daily from 10:00 AM until 5:00 PM (5:30 PM) ... €15 per adult, €9 per child (4–11). Children under 4 are free.

claim: The Belfry (Belfort) enforces strict timed-entry capacity limits and the 366-step climb should be pre-booked online, especially in peak season.
quote: The Belfry enforces strict capacity limits per time slot to manage visitor flow and preserve the monument, meaning popular times sell out very quickly.

claim: The Groeningemuseum (Flemish Primitives: Van Eyck, Memling, Bosch) is open Tuesday-Sunday 09:30-17:00, closed Mondays; €12 adult, €10 under-26, free under-16.
quote: The museum is open Tuesday through Sunday from 9:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. ... Tickets cost 12 euros for adults 26 and older and 10 euros for adults 25 and younger; youths 16 and younger enjoy free admission.

claim: Sint-Janshospitaal, holding six Memling masterpieces in one of Europe's oldest preserved hospital buildings, is open 09:30-17:00 and closed on Mondays.
quote: The museum is open from 9:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. and is closed on Mondays ... masterpieces by the Flemish primitive Hans Memling

claim: The Church of Our Lady museum houses Michelangelo's Madonna and Child - the only Michelangelo sculpture to have left Italy in his lifetime - alongside the ducal tombs.
quote: the Onze-Lieve-Vrouwekerk church in Bruges ... houses the famous sculpture by Michelangelo, the 'Madonna and Child'. This world-famous white marble statue is the only work by Michelangelo that left Italy during his lifetime.

claim: The Basilica of the Holy Blood on Burg square is free to enter and presents the relic for veneration daily 14:00-16:00 (and Fridays 10:15-11:00); treasury museum is €2.50.
quote: the relic of the Holy Blood is presented to visitors for veneration in the upper basilica in the afternoon from 2:00 pm to 4:00 pm, and every Friday morning from 10:15 am to 11:00 am.

claim: The UNESCO-listed Princely Beguinage Ten Wijngaerde (founded 1245) and adjacent Minnewater 'Lake of Love' are free to enter; the courtyard is open 06:30-18:30 daily and visitors are asked to observe silence.
quote: The 'Princely Beguinage Ten Wijngaerde' with its white-coloured house fronts and tranquil convent garden was founded in 1245 ... The beguinage is an authentic and lively place (of silence)

claim: A flat, well-paved cycle path along the Damse Vaart canal connects Bruges to Knokke-Heist via Damme over roughly 38 km of poplar-lined towpath - a viable bike option in good weather.
quote: a 38-kilometer path takes you from the heart of Bruges to the Belgian coast, specifically to the town of Knokke-Heist ... The cycle path is perfectly flat and well-paved, running parallel to the water.
